13.item: Optatum episcopum ad dexteram (apparatus: missing in one codex, perhaps to delete, cf. Greek)
13.sense_relied_on: kept as printed with the doubt recorded for the critic

13.item: Non tu es papa noster (papa = father/bishop)
13.sense_relied_on: art not thou our father — not the later papal title

13.item: quasi de Circo redeuntes et de factionibus certantes
13.sense_relied_on: as if back from the races, brawling over the factions
